mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% MoM does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPI does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) simultaneously drops by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combination signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of strong PAYEMS and dropping UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST rise > 10% MoM does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of economic expansion, a rise in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO rise > 1% MoM during expansion does not correlate with subsequent positive economic performance.
